title: End-of-Support for ZscalerOS 24 for Cloud Connector Deployments

blocks.text: Zscaler deployments with ZscalerOS 24 and earlier are no longer supported on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). If your organization is running a Cloud Connector deployment with ZscalerOS 24 or earlier, migrate to ZscalerOS 42 or higher by November 30, 2026 to ensure service continuity. No action is required for customers with Cloud Connectors running ZscalerOS 42.
